name: Landfill Disposals Tax Communities Scheme
summary: Welsh Government grants, run by WCVA, for community projects within five miles of eligible waste sites. One of the three themes is biodiversity: building resilient ecological networks for habitats and species.

geography.label: Wales, within five miles of eligible waste sites

amount.note: Plus one nationally significant project a year of £50,000 to £250,000

status.quote: Current status of the fund The fund is currently closed for applications.

administered_by.quote: The Landfill Disposals Tax Communities Scheme is a Welsh Government grant scheme administered by WCVA.

geography.quote: The Landfill Disposals Tax Communities Scheme will fund projects within five miles of certain waste transfer stations or landfill sites.

access.quote: To apply for the Landfill Disposals Tax Communities Scheme, you will need to register with WCVA's Multipurpose Application Portal (MAP).

window.quote: The map will be updated ahead of a funding round opening and will show eligible sites for that round.

amount.quote: Organisations can apply for grants of £5,000 to £49,999 for projects that align with at least one of the scheme's three themes. WCVA may award a grant to one nationally significant project per year, with a value of between £50,000 - £250,000
